title.description: Short slide title (max ~6 words), shown at the top of the slide and in the navigation menu.

feedback.description: Shown when the student selects this option: explains why it is right or wrong.

answers.description: 3-5 answer options; at least one correct and at least one incorrect.

all_correct.description: Shown when the student gets everything right. One sentence that reinforces the key idea.

not_all_correct.description: Shown otherwise. One sentence that points the student back to the key idea without giving away the answers.

path.description: Exact path of one of the supplied source images, e.g. 'images/cutting_geometry.png'.

alt_text.description: Concise description of what the image shows, for screen-reader users.

image.description: Image shown on this slide, or null for no image. Only supplied source images may be used.
